chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Muhammad ibn al-Walid, from Yunus, who said:

I said to Al-Reza (peace be upon him), 'Teach me a supplication and be brief.' So he (peace be upon him) said, 'Say: O One who pointed me to Himself and humbled my heart with believing in Him, I ask You for safety and faith.'
ai.seo_question: What is a short and comprehensive supplication for safety and faith according to Imam Al-Reza?
ai.summary: Recorded in Al-Kafi, this concise du'a emphasizes the prerequisite of self-knowledge ('dallani ala nafih') as the foundation for spiritual security and faith, reflecting the Shia emphasis on gnosis (ma'rifah) preceding supplication. It serves as a practical model for integrating theological understanding with devotional practice, ensuring that the petitioner's heart is humbled and aligned with divine truth before seeking worldly and otherworldly needs.
